I brought my dog to Blue pearl pet Hospital after he had an allergic reaction to his rabies vaccine. They were super friendly and attentive to both me and my Dog. The doctor, the receptionist, the nurse, and the environment were all calming. You never wanna have to go to a pet hospital, but if you do, you’re in good hands with BluePearl.

This is a thank-you letter to the BluePearl veterinary team—for everything you did, and everything you didn’t do.

Thank you to the lady at the front desk who told me the emergency check-in would cost $190, but then billed me $236. Thank you for telling me that placing the catheter would cost $120, then apologizing because you had “made a mistake” and the actual cost was $162—yet somehow, I was the one expected to pay for your mistake.

Thank you to the vet tech who took my baby to the back and never allowed me to be with her, despite my asking multiple times. I understand that you may have been following hospital policy, but ma’am, I was very specific about my cat’s severe anxiety and how terrified she was of everything. Listen to the recording you made of me when I brought her in. I repeatedly explained how anxious and frightened she was.

You told me you would check whether I could have her beside me in a room while she received oxygen. You never came back. Thank you!

Thank you to the male vet tech who later came out and started asking me the same questions the previous tech had already asked. Were you not communicating with your colleague, or were you trying to buy more time because something had gone wrong in the back?

That was the moment I became terrified that something was not right. I asked you to bring my cat back to me because I wanted to take her home.

And Mr. Vet Tech, your attitude during one of the worst moments of my life was something I will never forget. In case you don’t realize how it sounds to a terrified pet owner, repeatedly telling the front-desk employee to “collect the money from her,” right in front of me, was incredibly disrespectful and insensitive.

Thank you for finally allowing me to see my baby when, from what I could see, she was already in severe distress. Fear and stress were written all over her body. She looked obviously worse than when I brought her in, and she was struggling to breathe.

And finally, thank you to Dr. Escobar, whom I never got to see during the entire time I was there. Thank you for giving me no meaningful information about Cookie’s condition, diagnosis, or treatment plan. Thank you for not being able to spare even five minutes to speak with me face-to-face and explain what was happening to my baby.

Cookie was young. She came into your hospital with no known chronic conditions. What I desperately needed your team to understand was one thing: she was an extremely anxious cat. I told you that. I asked to stay with her. I asked you to consider how frightened she was. I trusted you to know how to handle her safely while taking that into account.

Instead, I watched her condition become dramatically worse.

Cookie died yesterday.

I will never know whether things would have been different if someone had listened to me, allowed me to stay with her, recognized how severely the stress was affecting her, or communicated with me about what was happening behind those doors. But I do know that I brought my baby to you looking for help, and what happened there will haunt me for the rest of my life.

I will never forgive how Cookie and I were treated during those final hours. I trusted you with someone I loved, and I left with an experience I would never wish on another pet owner.

I cannot recommend BluePearl, and based on my experience, I will tell other pet owners to stay away.

Don’t come here. Go to a trusted vet. The ER does not speak with internal medicine unless you specifically question them about it. My dog died because ER did not collaborate with internal medicine after we came in. We were referred to come here because they have an internal medicine department. My dogs death was avoidable and we found out too late it was autoimmune and he could have survived if he was treated when we came in the first time.

Caring for your pet is our top priority, and we always want to ensure you feel valued every step of the way. If there’s anything we could have done differently to make your visit better, we’d truly appreciate your insight. We’re always here to listen.

Very happy with this ER. We took Wallie to VEG ER 3 times over 3 days and every time we took him there he got worse and they just kept wanting us to keep bringing him in and paying for more expensive tests and medications and he was never improving, only getting worse. We brought him to BluePearl and told them we just wanted him to eat and drink again. They were very patient, gave very clear explanations for the plan and what they expected it to do, gave him some medicine, and let us wait around until we confirmed Wallie started eating and drinking again. They were planning to have us wait up to an hour but he was feeling much better within 15 minutes. They then gave very clear instructions on when and how much medication to give him when we brought him home with very clear written instructions so we wouldn't forget. Also they gave us more medication than the previous ER and charged us much less money. Come here, don't go to VEG, they'll take all of your money and accomplish nothing.
They did a great job, super helpful. Will come back to this ER if we ever need one.

Our dog was in severe pain, he wouldn’t eat and he couldn’t walk.

We took him to another vet 3 times in one weekend and they just said he was throwing a tantrum and that he would eat when he wanted to.

He didn’t eat for almost two days and we had kept bringing him everyday to another emergency vet. We were very stressed. We thought our dog was actively dying since he wasn’t eating, drinking or using his hind legs.

It was terrifying.

I called Blue Pearl and I was upset and crying the woman at the front desk was very sweet and told me to bring him in.

When we arrived they greeted Wallie by name (that’s our dog) and after a few minutes took us back with Wallie.

The nurse came in and got his information. After a little bit the vet came in the first time gave us an update on him. The vet himself came in twice to update us. When my husband came back into the room while the vet was talking and asked questions the vet patiently and politely explained everything again for my husband.

Wallie was brought back in and he was in much higher spirits. They gave us some water for him and he drank it so fast. They gave some wet food to him and he wolfed it down.

The vet came back in for a 3rd time to check on wallie and he made sure wallie was doing good before they sent him home.

They helped him so much. He’s pretty much back to his usual self now and I’m very happy.

From now on if we have another medical emergency with our cat or our wallie ball we are going to bring them back here. They are nice and understanding and help. They also are not trying to break your bank or only get money out of you.

The nurse also brought us his medication and told us the times and how much to give him and how often and sent us home with instructions which are very helpful.

The vets name was Dr Ying and he made sure to explain everything twice if needed and was very patient.

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are sorry to see that your experience did not meet your expectations. At BluePearl KATY, we strive to provide compassionate care, clear communication, and support to every family we serve, and we're disappointed to learn that we may have fallen short.

Because we don't have additional details about your visit, we would welcome the opportunity to learn more about your experience and see how we can improve. If you're willing, please reach out to our hospital leadership team so we can better understand your concerns.

Thank you for your feedback. We are always listening, learning, and working to provide the best possible experience for our patients and their families.

Sincerely,
 The BluePearl Katy Team 💙🐾
Always very professional, caring, understanding- any time of the day or night
The staff is wonderful at BluePearl. We have been going there over 10 years for pet emergencies. It is always a comfort knowing they are there to help our fur babies.
